desc: **DP state design**: Implement DP with `prev_char` (0..25), `cnt` (1..3). Initialize `dp[0]` by processing first character.
**Transitions**: Write transition to (a) extend same `c` (`k+1`, wrapped at 3), (b) close previous group (requires `k==3`) and start new group of any `c'`. Cost adds 1 if `s[i]!=chosen_char`.
**Cost + tie‑break storage**: Keep for each state `(cost, string)`. On lower cost replace; on equal cost keep lexicographically smaller string.
**Finalization**: After processing all chars, pick best among states with `cnt==3`; if none reachable return `""`, else return the stored string.
**Complexities & edge cases**: Verify n<3 always impossible; ensure transitions reset `cnt` correctly; ensure single‑character strings handled; finalize and test on provided examples.
